summary: Iteration 4 frontend testing complete. Verified masthead cleanup (no forest banner, no 3 pills), Column Notes end-to-end in single-desktop / single-mobile-card / batch modes, JSON log carries reviewer_note (and null for empty), PDF downloads succeed, presets carry notes into plan and JSON log, mobile 390 & tablet 820 layouts have no horizontal page overflow (findings ledger uses cards on mobile, table on tablet), title clamps within 390px, all 4 downloads work, no console errors. One minor UX polish issue: after applying a preset, the note textarea does not auto-open even though plan.note is set (user has to click 'add reviewer note' to see the pre-populated value — note itself is correct and flows to JSON).

ui_bugs.issue: After applying a preset that contains notesByHeader, the reviewer-note textarea does not auto-open. plan.note is populated correctly and flows into JSON log/PDF, but the UI still shows the 'add reviewer note' button. Root cause: NoteField uses `useState(openInitially || !!plan.note)` which only evaluates on mount; when the parent updates plan.note later via preset apply, the local `open` state does not re-derive. Fix: use a useEffect to sync `open` when `plan.note` becomes truthy, or lift `open` state / derive it from `plan.note` directly.

action_items: (Optional polish) DetectionView.NoteField: reactively open textarea when plan.note becomes non-empty (e.g. via preset apply). Suggested fix: `useEffect(() => { if (plan.note) setOpen(true); }, [plan.note]);`
(Optional) presets.applyPresetToPlan match counter — currently only counts transform changes; consider counting note-only updates so the toast reflects the real change count.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria for iteration 4 met. Masthead has no banner + no 3 pills (verified DOM + inner text). Column notes work in single-desktop, single-mobile-card, and batch modes. JSON log's transformations[i].reviewer_note is correctly populated (or null for empty). PDF download succeeds (~10KB). Tablet 820 uses desktop table variant (visible md:block), no page overflow. Mobile 390 uses cards (md:hidden) with no horizontal overflow anywhere (landing/findings/apply-result all bodySW=390). Presets do carry notes into plan.note and JSON log correctly. Only nit: after apply-preset the textarea remains collapsed until user clicks add-note (data still correct in plan+JSON). Consider fixing with useEffect in NoteField.
rca of the issue: NoteField open state is initialized via `useState(openInitially || !!plan.note)`. React initializes state only once on mount; subsequent prop changes to plan.note (as happens when parent replaces the entire columnPlan via applyPresetToPlan) do not re-derive `open`. Impact: cosmetic — the note is stored and exported correctly, but user must click 'add reviewer note' to see the pre-populated value. Fix: `useEffect(() => { if (plan.note) setOpen(true); }, [plan.note]);` inside NoteField.
